title: nvim-tree.lua caused neovim crashed

### Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC`

```
nvim -u NORC
# Alternative for shell-related problems:
# env -i TERM=ansi-256color "$(which nvim)"
```

### steps to reproduce the problem:

1  build the latest neovim
```bash
git clone https://github.com/neovim/neovim && cd neovim && make CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo && sudo make install

2 install `kyazdani42/nvim-tree.lua` with vim-plug

3  nvim-tree.lua config:

```vim
let g:lua_tree_auto_open = 1
let g:lua_tree_quit_on_open = 1
let g:lua_tree_auto_close = 1
let g:lua_tree_tab_open = 1
```
4  start nvim under any dir and open 2 or more tabs

```vim
:tabnew foo.txt
:tabnew bar.txt
```


### Actual behaviour

in tab foo.txt, run `:LuaTreeToggle<CR>` open the tree,
`gt` goto tab bar.txt, run `:LuaTreeToggle<CR>` open the tree,
then, cycle press `gt` twice or three times, 
neovim crashed
